rationale: The proposal is appropriate as an exploratory, investigational comparability test: it aligns with MISEV guidance and could identify lot-consistent, intact-EV-associated cargo without presuming a single active. However, substantial program-specific experimentation is required before any gating use—key risks include reproducible co‑isolation of non‑vesicular material (lipoproteins/aggregates), low‑biomass analytic sensitivity, assay‑induced artifacts (detergent/protease effects, capture‑reagent bias), and uncertain translational relevance. Proceed to defined experiments across ≥3 matched lots with rigorous secretome and buffer controls, orthogonal capture methods, spike‑ins, and detergent/protease protection tests to resolve these failure modes and demonstrate reproducibility and specificity prior to any operational adoption.
